title: Pink Party Jeep Tour in 3rd Ward HTX
blurb:
Hop on Houston’s first ever open-air pink Jeep Party Truck and experience the city like never before. Located in the historic 3rd Ward, this rolling celebration blends Houston culture, music, and pure fun with a BYOB experience that keeps the good vibes going.

Your Vibe Host keeps the energy high while you cruise through Houston hotspots including 3rd Ward, EaDo, and Midtown. Expect dancing, singing, fun party games like Hip Hop Bingo, and unforgettable moments as you roll through the city in style.

Bring your favorite drinks or grab our Chill Bundle for cups, water, and ice. Perfect for celebrations, friend groups, tourists, birthdays, girls’ nights, bachelor and bachelorette fun, or anyone who wants to experience Houston differently.

Public rides are 21+.
Minimum of 4 guests required or you will receive a full refund.
